research_question: Does weekly change in CFTC Legacy Non-Commercial Net/Open Interest contain predictive continuation information for the next five FX trading days once COT availability is PIT-safe?

hypothesis.primary: Positive weekly change in Non-Commercial Net/OI predicts positive subsequent local-currency-vs-USD return; negative change predicts negative subsequent return.
hypothesis.economic_interpretation: Fresh speculative positioning flow may persist into subsequent FX price action.

universe.usd_role: USD is the common counter-currency; USD COT contract is not used in the primary signal.

fx_return_definition.orientation: positive return always means local currency strengthens versus USD
fx_return_definition.entry: first available daily FX close on or after research_available_from
fx_return_definition.exit: fifth subsequent FX trading-day close after entry

test_statistic.primary_panel: For each ISO calendar week of entry, equal-weight all available OOS currency observation returns in that week; calculate panel performance from this chronological weekly portfolio series.
test_statistic.directional_accuracy: pooled OOS currency-week fraction with observation_return > 0; observation_return <= 0 counts as miss; NO_POSITION rows are excluded before this calculation
test_statistic.panel_max_drawdown: maximum peak-to-trough loss on exp(cumulative sum of chronological weekly_panel_return)

chronology.split_rule: Within each currency, first 60 percent of eligible labeled observations by entry date are diagnostic-only; final 40 percent are frozen OOS evaluation.
chronology.split_rounding: floor(0.60 * N) observations assigned to diagnostic segment

governance.contract_completion_note: Panel aggregation, Sharpe annualization, directional-accuracy treatment and drawdown definition were completed while status remained PREDECLARED_NO_RESULTS_OBSERVED and before any predictive performance was computed.
governance.if_fail: Keep COT as contextual positioning information; do not promote weekly flow to predictive score, production signal, or sizing input.
governance.if_pass: Classify only as research candidate requiring separate confirmation/forward validation before any production use.
